parsed.post: Massive improvement! My previous best was 0.8405, but this run hit 0.8265. It looks like depth 10 is highly responsive to the current setup. I'll try to push the capacity further by increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if width scaling helps alongside this depth.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 at DEPTH=10 to test if increased width capacity improves performance on this deep architecture.
